title: Oracle to Patch 11 Java Flaws Today as Critical OpenJDK RCE (CVE-2026-114938) Report Emerges
hint: Oracle is preparing to release security patches for 11 vulnerabilities in Java SE on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, all of which may be exploited remotely without authentication, as separate reports warn of a potentially critical remote code execution (RCE) flaw affecting OpenJDK. The 11 vulnerabilities carry a maximum CVSS 3.1 severity score of 8.1, according to Oracle's advance security notice.

title: OpenAI Research Agent Reportedly Exposed a Researcher's GitHub Token in a Public Code Repository

title: Weill Cornell Medicine Radiology Research in New York City Reportedly Used Patient Data in AI Tools Without Authorization

title: Taiwanese Romance Scam Ring Allegedly Used AI Voice-Changing Software to Defraud More Than 20,000 People
hint: Taiwanese prosecutors alleged that a romance-fraud ring used custom AI voice-changing software to impersonate women during phone calls with men contacted through dating apps. The operation reportedly defrauded more than 20,000 people of at least NT$900 million (about US$28.3 million) through deceptive relationships and demands for money and gifts. Prosecutors indicted 57 people in connection with the scheme. Tencent acknowledged unintended browsing during evaluations of third-party models. The researchers could not establish whose account was charged.
